---
title: "Development & Quality Checks"
---

Work on a feature branch and open a reviewable pull request. `measure-service` is an installed package, so tests must never rely on adding `src/` to `PYTHONPATH`. Scientific algorithm changes belong in `measure` or the relevant technique pack with reference tests there and an integration contract test here. Method resource calculations stay cleanly separated in `src/measure_methods`.

## Local verification suite

Install development and documentation extras into a virtual environment, then run repository-wide checks before opening a PR:

```sh
python -m venv .venv
.venv/bin/python -m pip install -e '.[dev,docs]'
.venv/bin/ruff check .
.venv/bin/ruff format --check .
.venv/bin/air format --check .
.venv/bin/jarl check .
.venv/bin/python scripts/render_reference.py --check
.venv/bin/python scripts/check_docs.py
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -m 'not r_backend and not bo_backend'
```

Use `ruff format .`, `ruff check . --fix`, and `air format .` to apply formatting fixes.

### Analytical & BO integration suites

Whenever you modify `worker.R`, numerical adapters, packaging, or method contracts, run the analytical integration suite with `measure` and corrected `measure.sec` installed:

```sh
MEASURE_MCP_TEST_R="$(command -v R)" .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -m 'not bo_backend'
MEASURE_MCP_R="$(command -v R)" .venv/bin/python examples/analyze_trace.py
```

When touching BO campaign adapters, set `MEASURE_BO_PYTHON` to an environment with the optional BO-MCP runtime and include `-m bo_backend`. Always report any skipped suites in your PR description.

### Distribution check

Build both the source archive and wheel, install the wheel into a fresh virtual environment, and verify entrypoints and packaged data (`worker.R`, `dad_report.js`, `benchmarks/reference_data/*`) from outside the checkout:

```sh
.venv/bin/python -m build
```

## Building the Great Docs site locally

With [Quarto](https://quarto.org/) and `.[docs]` installed:

```sh
.venv/bin/great-docs build
.venv/bin/great-docs preview
```

Regenerate `docs/tools.md` with `python scripts/render_reference.py --write` whenever MCP tool definitions change. The Great Docs MCP Reference pages introspect all 82 tools automatically from `measure_service.server:mcp` at build time.

## Documentation standard

- Describe implemented behavior in the present tense, and put proposed work in the [Ecosystem Roadmap](roadmap.qmd) with acceptance criteria.
- Use concrete nouns and verbs, omitting marketing claims and unsupported robustness assertions.
- Keep units, ownership, revision rules, idempotency semantics, and failure states explicit, and distinguish caller declarations from computed facts.
- Use synthetic or public examples only. Never include private application names, internal links, credentials, or confidential data.
- Keep commands executable and relative links valid. `scripts/check_docs.py` verifies local links across Markdown and Quarto files and validates complete JSON payloads against live MCP schemas.
